name: Voice
description: It's 3 minutes for hearers, but a life for the callers. A crime thriller chasing even the slightest sounds to rescue people's lives calling for urgent help.

credits_cast.character: Ko Won Gi [Vimo Island Emergency Call Team]
credits_cast.name: Yang Joo-ho

videos.title: A Story That Shouldn't Be Missed
A Story That Shouldn't Be Missed (2)
A Voice in the Dark
videos.overview: When Detective Moo Jin Hyuk's wife is brutally murdered, Kang Kwon Joo, an officer with superior auditory abilities, listens on the other end of the 911 call. Three years later, Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo find themselves working together.

videos.title: Healing Mother's Two Faces (1)
videos.overview: Jin Hyuk rushes to get to Bok Rim before it's too late. Kwon Joo compiles officers with varying expertise for her Golden Time Team.

videos.title: Healing Mother's Two Faces (2)
videos.overview: Time is running out for Ah Ram as Kwon Joo tries to decipher the xylophone sound. Kwon Joo tells Jin Hyuk her side of what happened three years ago.

videos.title: Dark Generic Bell Sound: The Secret of the Chocolate Box (1)
videos.overview: When Go Dong Chul's death is ruled a suicide, Kwon Joo realizes she must take things into her own hands. Jin Hyuk hurries to find the victim, whom he knows personally, of a kidnapping case.

videos.title: Dark Generic Bell Sound: The Secret of the Chocolate Box (2)
videos.overview: The clock is rapidly ticking for Kwon Joo as her captors prepare to bury her alive. Meanwhile, Eun Byul's own life is in danger as she's hidden in a location unknown to the police.

videos.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (1)
videos.overview: Kyung Il reveals to Kwon Joo that he witnessed her father's murder. Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo go off on their own, feeling closer than ever to finding the perpetrator.

videos.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (2)
videos.overview: When a dead body falls out of a supposed victim's closet, Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo realize the case goes much deeper than they had initially expected.

videos.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (3)
videos.overview: Jin Hyuk tries to escape the clutches of Good Friend, who don't quite live up to their name. The hunt for the perpetrator continues, but he is not an easy target.

videos.title: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (4)
videos.overview: An accusatory post about Hyun Ho appears online. The Center receives multiple calls when a night club suddenly turns into a nightmare.

videos.title: Devil's Whisperer (1)
videos.overview: Yang Ho Shik ambushes Eun Soo while Jin Hyuk and Dae Shik are led astray. Things become even more personal when Dong Woo is put in danger.

videos.title: Devil's Whisperer (2)
videos.overview: The elusive Nam Sang Tae prepares to flee the country, but the police are determined not to let him get away this time. A 911 call brings the Golden Time Team to a hostage situation on a rooftop.

videos.title: A Call From the Fiery Pit
videos.overview: Kwon Joo realizes they may have written off Baek Jin Gu's claims too quickly. Later, she finds troubling information related to the Eunhyung-dong case.

videos.title: The Birth of Satan (1)
videos.overview: Jin Hyuk goes to meet Nam Sang Tae by himself, hoping for answers. Kwon Joo looks deeper into the relationship between Ji Hye, Kong Chul Hwan, and GP Development.

videos.title: The Birth of Satan (2)
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose when Kwon Joo recognizes Tae Gu's voice. A serious bus accident threatens the lives of many, including a pregnant woman and a child.

videos.title: For the Last Golden Time (1)
videos.overview: As gas continues to leak from the bus, the chance of an explosion heightens. Jin Hyuk must face the undeniable truth about Dae Shik.

videos.title: For the Last Golden Time (2)
videos.overview: Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo sneak into Tae Gu's killing lair, unaware Dae Shik is inside. Can they capture the crazed murderer before he escapes? Find out in the thrilling series finale.

videos.title: The Second Golden Time
videos.overview: When a criminal mastermind goes after one of their own, the Golden Time Team's Kang Kwon Joo butts heads with other cops over the crime. Detective Do Kang Woo sees the parallels with a murder in his past.

videos.title: The Beginning of the Hunt
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the crash, the mastermind runs free. Director Kang Kwon Joo aims to team up with Detective Do, but it'll be harder than she thought, and the case unfurls into something much darker.

videos.title: Time For Judgement
videos.overview: A convicted child rapist is released from prison and strikes again, to the anguish of the victim's family. Detective Do chases an all-too-familiar suspect, but nothing remains in his grasp.

videos.title: Shh! It's a Customer's Secret (1)
videos.overview: With Kwak Min Soo in the grasp of law enforcement, the situation is turned on its head when someone gets through their safe walls. An old man finds the suicide of his friend, but nothing is as it seems.

videos.title: Shh! It's A Customer's Secret (2)
videos.overview: With the life of Detective Park's wife on the line, the Golden Time Team chases after malicious voice phishers who attacked an old lady for her money.

videos.title: The Accomplices with the Star Coins (1)
videos.overview: Director Kang and Detective Do chase a stunning possible lead. An online show host makes a blood-chilling discovery in an abandoned military base.

videos.title: The Accomplices with the Star Coins (2)
videos.overview: The "zombie girl" makes her way into a nearby town, and the Golden Time Team does its best to get to her first. Director Kang is become unsure of Captain Do when she receives mysterious photos.

videos.title: I Got Flowers Today (1)
videos.overview: A pair of corpses are found on the harbors of Poongsan, and Detective Do chases the slightest hint of connection to his case. Agent Park's past troubles catch up with her and threaten her safety.

videos.title: I Got Flowers Today (2)
videos.overview: The Golden Time Team runs into twists at every turn in the case of Agent Park's abduction. Detective Do's blackouts make trouble for him again as he loses his grip on reality.

videos.title: The Creation of Hatred
videos.overview: Detective Do is thrust into a high-stakes hunt with all of Poongsan's cops out for whoever's behind the disappearance of one of their own.

videos.title: Era Of Hate
videos.overview: The serial killer reveals himself to Detective Do and Director Kang, but it only makes him lash out even more as he goes to teach the Golden Time Team a lesson.

videos.title: Era of Hate: For the Golden Time Team!
videos.overview: With the serial killer brazenly turning himself in, Director Kang can't help but think something's off. Bang Jae Soo explosively pushes Detective Do to face his past, but not everything can come out in the end.

videos.title: The Third Golden Time!
videos.overview: Kang Kwon Joo is still recovering from the explosion that severely injured her.

videos.title: An Evil Lives in Shishiodoshi Ryokan!
videos.overview: Soon after meeting with Kang Woo, the team gets a call from a tourist. She says a psychopath kidnapped her and is about to kill her

videos.title: Pinocchio's Song
videos.overview: Kang Woo returns to Korea and reports to the higher ups about what he has been doing and the cartel that is behind Doctor Fabre

videos.title: Dark Secret Behind Soo Cheol
videos.overview: The Golden Time Team gets a call about a kid named Pyo Hyun Soo. He is a kid suffering from Asperger's syndrome. However, his guardian, Song Soo Cheol, seems to be manipulating Hyun Soo

videos.title: The Secret Of Sumpitan
videos.overview: Je Soo is able to escape after faking a suicide. Soon after his escape, he comes across someone. Even when the Golden Time Team responds immediately, they lost Je Soo

videos.title: The Revenge
videos.overview: The perpetrator that shot poisonous darts has been apprehended. She reveals she wanted revenge for what Director Cheon has done to her

videos.title: The Accelerator To The Abyss
videos.overview: Hong Soo catches Kang Woo interrogating Burying Beetle at Port Poongsan. While trying to stop Kang Woo, Burying Beetle gets away. However, not everything is for naught, as Kang Woo now knows a clue related to Wire Shun. Meanwhile, the Golden Time Team gets a call from a man saying someone drunk or high has beaten him up.

videos.title: Someone Has Kidnapped Jin Sik
videos.overview: A man suspected of being Wire Shun, Fujiyama Koichi, is located at Club Blackhole. Although Kang Woo chases after him, Fujiyama gets away. Moreover, the police lose Jin Sik while he went to the bathroom. After inspecting the bathroom, Kang Woo suspects someone has kidnapped Jin Sik. Meanwhile, Cho Rong searches more about Fujiyama and comes across important information on Kang Woo.

videos.title: Is Your Life All Right? (1)
videos.overview: While searching through the area, the perpetrator makes Kang Woo turn and attack Kwon Joo. She confirms that Kang Woo is unstable and asks him to turn his gun and police badge in. The Dispatch Team finds the dead bodies of Fujiyama and his henchman. Kang Woo suspects there is someone else who controlled Fujiyama and believes this case is far from over.

videos.title: Is Your Life All Right? (2)
videos.overview: The team arrives at Dr. Hwang’s Clinic and apprehends Choo Dong Goo, who has been causing a scene. Dong Goo claims Doctor Hwang hid his soon-to-be wife, Se Mi, and something horrible has happened to her. Although Kang Woo said he wouldn’t meddle in today’s case, he spots blood in the operation room. He realizes something is off and thinks Se Mi got kidnapped.

videos.title: The Secret Of Sameta
videos.overview: Yukiko’s husband, Kaneki Masayuki, seems like an amazing professor loved by his students who stand up for human rights. Kwon Joo and Kang Woo come across him while checking on Fujiyama Koichi’s autopsy. Meanwhile, Goto Naomi, a worker who worked for Yukiko, finds a camera installed in one of the paintings that recorded the day Yukiko got murdered.

videos.title: Kang Woo Quits His Job
videos.overview: Soon after Naomi brought the painting and the camera, she gets killed. Her body was displayed just like the painting she had brought which makes the Golden Time Team think it was done by someone related to Auction Fabre. Meanwhile, Kang Woo quits his job and tries to go after the perpetrator by his way.

videos.title: Golden Time Team's Crisis
videos.overview: While searching the Blackhole Club, Hong Soo gets ambushed and abducted by one of Kaneki’s henchman. Thankfully, even while his hands are tied, Hong Soo gives the team some information. With the information, the team locates where Hong Soo is. Kang Woo gets to the location before the team arrives and goes after the abductor.

videos.title: Disband The Golden Time Team
videos.overview: Hong Soo gets tortured and murdered by Jeon Chang Soo. Due to this incident, police headquarters decide to disband the Golden Time Team. The team, however, gets a few days to catch the real owner of Auction Fabre. Meanwhile, Kang Woo is going solo and tries to figure out why Professor Kaneki is so obsessed with him.

videos.title: The City Of Accomplices
videos.overview: Dispatch Team heads over to the location Kang Woo confined Chang Soo. But when they arrive at the place, Chang Soo is found dead. Meanwhile, Kang Woo is trying to find out about Kaneki’s past and goes to an old maid that worked at the Kaneki household in the past. The information the maid gives is rather shocking and makes Kang Woo remember his past.

videos.title: Kaneki Is Stowing Away To Japan
videos.overview: After obtaining Kaneki’s cellphone, the Golden Time Team locates where Kaneki went frequently. There, the team finds Congressman Makio along with the rotting bodies. But not long after such discovery, poisonous gas starts fill the building up. Meanwhile, Kaneki is heading over to his hideout, and the team thinks he is stowing away to Japan.

videos.title: New Emails
videos.overview: Strange emails are sent to Kwon Joo. She thinks they’re just prank emails, but soon, she realizes the emails have been forewarning her of murders. She starts to track down who sent the emails. Meanwhile, Derek Cho, a detective from the U.S., is working temporarily in Korea. He has a younger sister who has a speech impediment, but she’s abducted and in danger.

videos.title: The Face Of The Suspect
videos.overview: Kwon Joo and Derek finally meet in person at the Vimo Provincial Police Agency. However, when Derek checks the suspect’s face on the CCTV footage from the airport, he does not hesitate to point his gun at Kwon Joo. Meanwhile, a call comes in about a mysterious wild animal that dragged a person off in Mosim Forest.

videos.title: The Phone Call From The Victim
videos.overview: The call center receives a phone call from the missing woman, Jang Ye Sook. Kwon Joo tries her best to hear anything over the phone that might help the team get to Ye Sook in time. Meanwhile, Derek, who joins the Golden Time Team, finds a piece of clothing with a bite mark on it. The team puts all of their effort into saving the victim before it is too late.

videos.title: The Body In The Cauldron
videos.overview: The Golden Time Team heads to the hospital in search of the fleeing suspect, Gong Su Ji. Meanwhile, Han Woo Ju, a cyber agent who runs the fansite for the Golden Time Team, brings in a helpful clue. Then, a call center receives a report about a haenyeo who claims to have seen her granddaughter’s dead body in a cauldron in the sea.

videos.title: Running Away From Danger
videos.overview: Kwon Joo’s team and Derek continue to look for Su Ji and Ga Eun. Su Ji’s belongings and what seems to be her will are found near the beach, and the local police officers assume that Su Ji committed suicide. Meanwhile, Ga Eun who was abducted by the drug smugglers tries to run away, risking her life.

videos.title: Circus Man's Multiple Personalities
videos.overview: Kwon Joo’s profiling leads to the conclusion that the Circus Man is in fact a man with multiple personalities. Derek and the Golden Time Team continue questioning the suspect as Dae Shik rejoins the dispatch team. Meanwhile, a call comes into the 112 call center from a man who is being chased by someone with a knife. Kwon Joo sends the Golden Time Team to the scene.

videos.title: 28 Years Ago
videos.overview: Kang Man Ho’s father, Kang Seok Chun, is supposedly dead on paper. However, he is still alive, and his hidden story comes to light. Meanwhile, Derek hears the truth from Director Yang about his mom’s death 28 years ago. Also, Woo Ju sets up a trap online to catch the Circus Man. Meanwhile, a mysterious user approaches him.

videos.title: The Missing Teen
videos.overview: The Golden Time Team conducts a discreet operation to catch the user they believe to be Circus Man. Meanwhile, Eun Soo volunteers to transfer to the dispatch team. As they chase down Circus Man, a local high school teacher calls the 112 Call Center about his student who has gone missing after leaving an ominous voicemail.

videos.title: Hidden Room
videos.overview: Derek and Dae Shik finally catch the man who is suspected to have abducted and confined Saet Byul and Hyo Joon in a motel room. But he says he was also forced by a woman for money. Eun Soo manages to enter the motel and finds a path that leads to a hidden room. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo bumps into a stranger in a stairway, but she instantly recognizes him by his voice.

videos.title: Short Kidnapper
videos.overview: The man who Kwon Joo bumped into in the stairway was Dong Bang Min. He threatens Kwon Joo with a knife. Fortunately, Derek and Dae Sik arrive to save Kwon Joo. Dong Bang Min soon gets released thanks to the connection between the Commissioner General and his grandfather, the head of Sonang Village. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo and Derek find out more about Joo Bum Tae from his schoolmate. And they also hear about a kidnapper who is quite short.

videos.title: Kwak Man Taek's Confession
videos.overview: The Golden Time Team arrests and interrogates Kwak Man Taek, the man who works for Dong Bang Min, after he confesses that he is the Circus Man. However, during the interrogation, he has a seizure and acts very strangely. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo figures something out while analyzing Dong Bang Min’s many voices. Then, someone breaks into the Golden Time Team’s lodgings.

videos.title: The Vimo Plant
videos.overview: Kwon Joo and Derek chase after the person who snuck into the dorm. Kwon Joo sees something from a past dream that she had. Derek saves her from imminent danger, and they find out why they both saw strange visions. As the secrets of Sonang Village slowly come to light, Woo Ju informs the team that Saet Byeol has disappeared from the shelter.
